ValidationRule.description: Anticipated Registered Donors is required for Fixed Sites whose Operation Type is "Non Integrated WB"
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( Is_Template__c != True, Account.RecordType.Name = "Fixed Site Account", OR(Anticipated_Registered_Donors__c == 0, ISBLANK(Anticipated_Registered_Donors__c)), ISPICKVAL(Drive_Site__r.Operation_Type__c, "Non Integrated WB"))
ValidationRule.errorMessage: A non-zero value is required for Anticipated Registered Donors because the Site's Operation Type is "Non Integrated WB"
